milestones: 2026-08-18 personal forwarding rule removed; 2026-09-15 forwarding blocked; 2026-10-15 AI terms signed or FCI uploads stopped for good

weakness: Backup console and firewall management login accept a password alone; SYS-01 company administrators have no MFA
